bio.text: Samantha Mota is the Democratic candidate for California's 37th Congressional District in 2026.
According to the campaign website, Mota was born and raised in Los Angeles County, attended Santa Monica College for political science, and now lives in Baldwin Hills.
The site's timeline says Mota was appointed in January 2021 to Santa Monica's Public Safety Reform & Oversight Commission and was a Santa Monica City Council candidate in August 2022.
